_comment: Spoken lines for The Great Present Peek. Every speaker id must exist in scripts/voice-cast.json. Input to scripts/generate-peek-voices.py. Keep lines short (under ~4 seconds spoken), warm, funny, never scary — the guests are family setting up the party.

narrator.intro: It was the night before the birthday, and two small shadows were not asleep. Down the stairs they crept, to peek at the presents.
narrator.floor: Down another floor, quiet as moonlight.
narrator.party: Oh! A party landing! Balloons and cake everywhere!
narrator.spotted: Ooh, spotted! Back to the rug, little shadows.
narrator.best: Your very best sneak ever! The moon herself is impressed.

spotted: Ooh ooh ooh! I see you, I see you, I see BOTH of you!
Two sneakers! Sneaking! At night! Back to bed, sneakers!
Ha! Found you found you found you!
hmm: Did something whoosh? Something whooshed. I know a whoosh.
Hmm hmm hmm — my whiskers are tingling!

spotted: Hello, small ones. Bed is that way.
I see you. Slowly. Back you go.
Hm. Two peekers. Big day tomorrow.
A-ha! Caught you, little sneaks! Off to bed!
Nice try, you two! But nobody sneaks past me.
Spotted! And I'm not even sorry. Bedtime!
hmm: Hmm. My big-sister senses are tingling.
Was that a footstep? I know footsteps.

spotted: Oh! Little ones. Shh — back to bed now.
I see you, sweet shadows. Off you go now.
Found you. Gently, gently, back upstairs.
hmm: Hmm... did the shadows just giggle?

spotted: Caught! Deliciously caught!
Two tiny plotters! I adore it. To bed!
You dare sneak past ME? Magnificent. Bedtime anyway.
hmm: Something is afoot. Something SMALL is afoot.

spotted: Bed. Now.
Seen.
No.
Mm, there you are, my little moons. Back to bed, you two.
I knew you'd try, sweet ones. Upstairs now.
Peeking already? The presents can wait one more sleep.
hmm: Hmm. Two little heartbeats, somewhere close.
My whiskers say somebody is not asleep.

spotted: Woof! Two little peekers! Back to bed, you two!
Well, well! Caught you, pups! Up you go.
A-woof! I spy two sleepy sneakers!
hmm: Hmm? Woof. My ears heard a tiptoe.
Ho hum... something small and giggly went past.

spotted: There you are. I was watching. Bed now.
I never sleep. But you should. Go on.
Seen you. Upstairs, please.
hmm: Hmm. The quiet just got quieter.
